work_orders.title: Spindle vibration check
work_orders.description: Operator reported elevated vibration at 8000 rpm. Inspected spindle bearings and re-torqued drawbar.

work_orders.title: Replace oil separator element
work_orders.description: Scheduled 4000-hour service. Replaced oil filter and separator element, checked belt tension.

work_orders.title: Belt tracking misalignment
work_orders.description: Belt drifting to the left side. Adjusting tail pulley and inspecting idler rollers.

work_orders.title: Hydraulic oil leak at cylinder
work_orders.description: Seal leak on main cylinder rod. Replaced rod seals and topped up ISO VG 46 oil.

work_orders.title: Servo alarm on axis 3
work_orders.description: Robot stopped with servo alarm on axis 3. Checking encoder cable and motor brake.

work_orders.title: Coolant pump seal inspection
work_orders.description: Preventive inspection of mechanical seal and impeller. No leakage found.
